subject: BrightSide Marketplace spotlight — quote + logo approval

Subject: BrightSide Marketplace spotlight — short quote + logo permission

Hi Helen,

Thanks again for the time on Tuesday. We're putting together a short Spotlight listing for BrightSide Health on the GCP Marketplace (co-sell badge track) and wanted to check if you could provide: 1) a 1-2 sentence customer quote we can publish on the listing, and 2) permission to use BrightSide's logo (high-res PNG or SVG).

To make this easy, I've attached a one-page preview of how the blurb will appear in the listing and a suggested quote we drafted for you. Feel free to edit for tone or accuracy. If legal sign-off is needed on usage terms, let me know who on your side we should loop in.

Suggested quote (editable):
“Redwood’s inference platform reduced our model latency and simplified multi-cloud deployment, letting us serve clinicians with consistently fast responses.”

If you can reply with a final sentence and either attach the logo or confirm we can pull from your brand folder, that would be great. Our goal is to go live the week of Aug 9, so a quick confirm by end of next week would keep us on schedule.

Thanks —

I attached a short blurb draft with two variants (one with the numeric claim tied to our eval, one that is more general). Can you weigh in on which to use for the GCP Spotlight? Also, legal wants a signed logo use release before we publish.

Quick asks:
- Laura: Can you pick the wording variant you prefer and confirm we can proceed with Spotlight copy?
- Vivek: Once we have the go/no-go, can you confirm whether co-sell badge ops need any extra artifacts from BrightSide?

I've added the marketing_blurb_draft.md as an attachment. If both approve, I'll send Helen the DocuSign link and request the high-res SVG.

Thanks,
Aditya

“Redwood’s inference platform cut our production latency and made cross‑cloud deployments predictable, significantly improving clinician workflow.”

Vivek — once Helen signs the release we can proceed with the Spotlight and apply for the GCP co-sell badge. From an ops standpoint we’ll want the SVG plus a square PNG at 400x400 for the listing.
